title: Nintendo Switch Collection
description: The portable shelf — indies, RPGs, and the games that justify carrying a console in 2026.
personalNote: The Switch is my commute cathedral. These are the carts that never leave the travel case.

items.notes: Played entirely handheld on commutes. Still discovering secrets.
